name: marin
description: Open-source framework for the research and development of foundation models.
one_liner: An open-source toolkit and public research log for training large AI models from scratch, sharing every step — including the failures.
buyer: Honestly not a commercial buyer — this is a research platform for AI labs and academics, not a small-business tool.
business_use_cases: A university AI lab uses it to train and transparently document domain-specific models (e.g. for DNA or protein research).
A startup studies its published experiment logs to avoid known pretraining mistakes and save compute costs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a consulting service helping smaller labs adopt this framework and avoid costly training mistakes.

steal_this: Not really a weekend project — more useful as free tuition: read its failed-experiment logs before you spend money training your own model.
